The '''black cipher''' was an encryption device that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] after its development by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Known to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the "'''Umbra encrypter'''", the cipher was considered to be the most advanced encryption machine ever designed, allowing seamless, undetectable communications and encryption.

==History==
In [[3640 BBY]], only seventeen intact ciphers existed, with fifteen installed aboard the Empire's largest [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and the remaining two in the [[Minister of Logistics]]' office in the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]] and in the possession of [[Darth Marr]]. During the early stages of the [[Galactic War]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] worked with [[Havoc Squad]] to reassemble a black cipher from wreckage on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] tried many times to retrieve ciphers from Imperial ships but were foiled by their [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanisms]]. What's more, if the Empire became aware that the black cipher was compromised, they'd recall all their capital ships to change the codes. The successful theft of the Minister of Logistics' cipher was a key part of [[Operation End Game]].
